Client Portal

Email was never built for confidential documents

Every attachment you send leaves your control the moment it's sent. For a law firm, that's a professional risk — and a daily annoyance.

No control

Once a file is emailed, you can't revoke it, expire it, or know who forwarded it.

Version chaos

"Contract_final_v3_DEF(2).docx" — nobody knows which version is the real one.

Size limits

Case files, exhibits and scans routinely bounce against mailbox limits.

No overview

Documents for one matter end up scattered across dozens of email threads.

A secure portal your clients actually use

Simple for clients

Representatives receive an onboarding email, set their own password once, and from then on see exactly their documents and dossiers — no software to install, no manual to read.

Your firm's branding

The portal carries your firm's name and logo, so clients always know who they're dealing with.

Automatic notifications

You're notified the moment a client uploads a document — and clients see when something is waiting for them.

You decide who sees what, for how long

Per-document permissions

Share a single document or a whole matter folder. Grant view-only or download rights, per person.

Expiring links

Set an expiry date on anything you share. After that, access simply stops — no chasing required.

Revoke at any time

Shared something by mistake, or a matter has closed? Withdraw access with one click.

Every document in its place, automatically

Organised by matter

Files live inside the case they belong to — together with the notes, tasks and correspondence of that matter.

Version history

Larx keeps every version of a document. Compare, restore or refer back — the current version is always unmistakable.

Fast full-text search

Find any document by name, client, matter or content — in seconds, not minutes.

Security a law firm can stand behind

Confidentiality isn't a feature for a law firm — it's an obligation. Larx is built to meet it.

Encrypted end to end

Documents are encrypted in transit and at rest. Nobody outside your firm and your client can read them.

EU data residency

All data is stored on servers within the European Union, fully GDPR compliant.

Complete audit trail

Every view, download and share is logged — so you can always demonstrate who accessed what, and when.

Two-factor access

Portal access is protected with two-factor verification, for your team and your clients alike.

Up and running in minutes

Create a matter

Add the case and drop in the documents that belong to it — drag and drop, straight from your desktop.

Invite your client

Send a secure invitation. Your client gets access to exactly the documents you choose — nothing more.

Share and track

Exchange documents both ways and follow everything in the audit trail. No more attachment ping-pong.

Frequently asked questions

How do my clients get access?

Your firm creates the account: the representative receives an onboarding email, clicks the link, sets a personal password — and immediately sees their own environment with exactly the dossiers they've been given access to. Nothing to install, nothing to configure.

Is there a limit on file size or storage?

Larx handles large case files, scans and media without the size limits of email. Storage depends on your plan — see pricing for details.

Where is my data stored?

All documents are stored encrypted on servers within the European Union, in line with GDPR requirements for legal professionals.

Can I migrate documents from my current system?

Yes. You can upload existing folders in bulk, and we help you map them onto clients and matters during onboarding.

What happens when a matter is closed?

You can archive the matter: client access ends automatically, while your firm keeps the complete file and audit trail for its retention period.
